# Shivukim — B2B Wholesale Supply for Institutions & Businesses

> Shivukim (שיווקים) is a leading Israeli supplier of professional cleaning chemicals, paper & hygiene products, Tork dispensers, office stationery, and disposable goods for institutions, schools, offices, guest houses (צימרים), and commercial facilities.

## Core Links
- [Product Catalog](https://wer-308.pages.dev/): Full interactive B2B product catalog with real-time search, category navigation, and WhatsApp ordering.
- [Express Order Sheet](https://wer-308.pages.dev/order.html): Fast spreadsheet-style bulk ordering form for institutional buyers.
- [Customer Service & Sales](tel:0505178445): Direct phone line to Sales Manager Shmuel Levi (050-5178445).
- [WhatsApp Direct Dispatch](https://wa.me/972505178445): Instant order submission and support via WhatsApp.

## Product Categories
- [Tork Dispensers & Refills](https://wer-308.pages.dev/#catalog/tork): Premium commercial hygiene dispensers, SmartOne toilet paper, folded towels, and refills.
- [Paper & Wiping Goods](https://wer-308.pages.dev/#catalog/paper): Crepe paper towels, industrial centerfeed rolls, medical examination paper, and napkins.
- [Professional Cleaning & Disinfection](https://wer-308.pages.dev/#catalog/cleaning): Concentrated bleach, degreasers, floor shine detergents, sanitizers, and hand soaps.
- [Air Fresheners & Scent Diffusers](https://wer-308.pages.dev/#catalog/scents): Commercial electric fragrance diffusers and high-end aerosol scent refills.
- [Cleaning Equipment & Tools](https://wer-308.pages.dev/#catalog/tools): Industrial squeegees, microfiber cloths, brooms, telescopic handles, and mop sets.
- [Heavy-Duty Trash Bags](https://wer-308.pages.dev/#catalog/bags): Municipal-grade 75x90, 80x100, and 90x110 black and HD liners for bins.
- [Disposable Tableware & Packaging](https://wer-308.pages.dev/#catalog/disposables): Hot drink cups, wooden cutlery, meal containers, foil, and cling film.
- [Hospitality & Guest House Supplies](https://wer-308.pages.dev/#catalog/hospitality): Guest amenities, miniature shampoo & body wash, wrapped soaps, and vanity packs.
- [Office & School Supplies](https://wer-308.pages.dev/#catalog/office): Copy paper (A4 80g), markers, staplers, tape, and daily office consumables.
